name: aidd-team
description: Run the aidd loop as a delivery team of agent roles, led by you, an agent, or both, with you deciding the risky steps you keep or delegating them: product-manager, delivery-manager, architect, product-designer, security-engineer, compliance-analyst, domain-expert, developer, tech-writer, verifier, reviewer, delegate, sre, and agile-coach agents, each applying its discipline's standards and writing only its own files, plus a domain pack per domain (web, APIs, mobile, desktop, AI features, AI agents, data, cloud, payments, health, embedded, public sector, children, internationalization) and practice skills for kinds of work such as schema migration, threat modeling, test design, estimation, proposals, and release rollout. One command per team flow: onboard, propose, plan, refine, mvp, explore, specify, implement, review, rework, fix, rollout, handover, postmortem, retro, and maintain, each telling the session that runs it to route by file path and name each role's model, plus autopilot, which runs those flows between human decisions. Works with git alone; a forge, a tracker, or any other service is optional. Needs the aidd plugin.
